_readme: Trace It's built-in line drawings: original art only (no characters, logos or crests). Each drawing has a 'size' box, its teaching 'steps' (EN + _es) and 'strokes' in that box's units. Stroke kinds: line [x0,y0,x1,y1], rect [x0,y0,x1,y1], poly [x,y,...] (+ "closed": true), curve [x,y,...] (smooth, through every point; closed when the last point repeats the first), circle [cx,cy,r], ellipse [cx,cy,rx,ry,degrees]. 'step' = which step the stroke belongs to (0 first). The game draws the strokes itself, so a drawing costs a few hundred bytes. Courses will list drawings from here by id.

steps.name: Guide lines
steps.tip: Draw the five long straight lines. They cross in the middle -- that's fine.
steps.tip_es: Dibuja las cinco líneas largas y rectas. Se cruzan en el medio, no pasa nada.

steps.name: Outline
steps.tip: Now go over the outside edge only, firmly.
steps.tip_es: Ahora repasa solo el borde de afuera, con firmeza.

steps.name: Big shapes
steps.tip: A box and a triangle on top. Light lines, don't press yet.
steps.tip_es: Una caja y un triángulo arriba. Líneas suaves, todavía sin apretar.

steps.name: Door and windows
steps.tip: Smaller boxes inside the big one. Check they line up.
steps.tip_es: Cajas más chicas dentro de la grande. Fíjate que queden alineadas.

steps.name: Details
steps.tip: Chimney, window frames, the door knob and the ground.
steps.tip_es: Chimenea, marcos de las ventanas, el picaporte y el suelo.

steps.name: Head
steps.tip: One big circle. Go round in one smooth movement, from the shoulder.
steps.tip_es: Un círculo grande. Dibújalo de un solo movimiento suave, desde el hombro.

steps.name: Ears
steps.tip: Two triangles that start and end on the circle.
steps.tip_es: Dos triángulos que empiezan y terminan sobre el círculo.

steps.name: Face
steps.tip: Eyes, nose, mouth and whiskers. The eyes sit halfway down the head.
steps.tip_es: Ojos, nariz, boca y bigotes. Los ojos van a mitad de la cabeza.

steps.name: Centre and stem
steps.tip: A small circle, then one long gentle curve down.
steps.tip_es: Un círculo chico y después una curva larga y suave hacia abajo.

steps.name: Petals
steps.tip: Six ovals around the centre, like the hours on a clock.
steps.tip_es: Seis óvalos alrededor del centro, como las horas de un reloj.

steps.name: Leaves
steps.tip: Two leaves on the stem, then a line down the middle of each.
steps.tip_es: Dos hojas en el tallo y una línea por el medio de cada una.
